blocks.zh: 範圍與觀測設備
blocks.en: Scope and Observation Equipment

blocks.zh: 可見異物的定義
blocks.en: Definition of Visible Particles

blocks.zh: 「可見異物（Visible particles）」指粒徑通常>50–100 µm的粒子，在規定光照條件下可被正常視力目視發現（不借助放大鏡）。與次可見微粒（Sub-visible，>10 µm但<100 µm，需儀器量測）不同。Ph.Eur. 2.9.20是可見異物的藥典標準方法，而2.9.19則涵蓋次可見微粒的儀器測試方法。
blocks.en: "Visible particles" are particles that are generally >50–100 µm in size and can be detected by normal eyesight under defined lighting conditions (without a magnifying aid). They differ from sub-visible particles (>10 µm but <100 µm, which require instrumental measurement). Ph.Eur. 2.9.20 is the pharmacopoeial standard method for visible particles, while 2.9.19 covers the instrumental test methods for sub-visible particles.

blocks.zh: 觀測站四個組件說明
blocks.en: The Four Components of the Inspection Station

blocks.zh: A霧面黑色背景板（垂直）：黑色背景讓白色、亮色、透明粒子產生對比，易於發現。
blocks.en: AMatt black background panel (vertical): the black background gives contrast to white, light-colored and transparent particles, making them easy to see.

blocks.zh: B無反光白色背景板（垂直）：白色背景讓深色、有色粒子產生對比，與A板交替使用。
blocks.en: BNon-glare white background panel (vertical): the white background gives contrast to dark and colored particles; it is used alternately with panel A.

blocks.zh: C無反光白色底板（水平）：作為底部反光補充，提高容器底部異物的能見度。
blocks.en: CNon-glare white base panel (horizontal): provides supplementary reflected light from below and improves the visibility of foreign matter at the bottom of the container.

blocks.zh: D遮光燈具：白光、有擴散器，照度2000–3750 lux。有色玻璃/有色製劑可適當提高照度。
blocks.en: DShielded light source: white light with a diffuser, illumination 2000–3750 lux. For colored glass or colored preparations, the illumination may be increased as appropriate.

blocks.zh: 照度規定的意義
blocks.en: Why the Illumination Is Specified

blocks.zh: 2000–3750 lux 是依據人眼最佳可見異物偵測能力設計的照度範圍——太暗（<2000 lux）容易漏檢，太亮（>3750 lux）可能在無色透明液體中產生眩光干擾。此照度範圍與PDA TR85《Enhanced Particle Detection》及USP <790>/<1790>的要求一致。
blocks.en: The 2000–3750 lux range is designed around the eye's best ability to detect visible particles: too dim (<2000 lux) and particles are easily missed; too bright (>3750 lux) and glare may interfere in colorless, clear liquids. This range is consistent with PDA TR85 "Enhanced Particle Detection" and the requirements of USP <790>/<1790>.

blocks.zh: 操作方法詳解
blocks.en: Operating Method in Detail

blocks.zh: 操作程序關鍵步驟
blocks.en: Key Steps of the Procedure

blocks.zh: 移除標籤：若容器有標籤遮擋，需先移除以確保可以看見容器內全部區域。
blocks.en: Remove labels: if a label obstructs the view, remove it first so that the whole interior of the container can be seen.

blocks.zh: 輕旋或顛倒：使內容物中的微粒懸浮，同時避免引入氣泡（氣泡可能被誤判為粒子）。動作要輕柔——不是劇烈搖晃。
blocks.en: Swirl gently or invert: this suspends any particles in the contents while avoiding the introduction of air bubbles (bubbles may be mistaken for particles). The movement should be gentle, not vigorous shaking.

blocks.zh: 白色背景（B）觀察：約5秒，不使用放大鏡。白色背景適合偵測深色粒子（如橡膠顆粒、金屬粒子、焦糖色雜質）。
blocks.en: Observe against the white background (B): for about 5 seconds, without a magnifying aid. The white background suits the detection of dark particles (such as rubber fragments, metal particles and caramel-colored impurities).

blocks.zh: 黑色背景（A）觀察：重複觀察。黑色背景適合偵測白色、透明、亮色粒子（如玻璃碎片、蛋白質聚集體、結晶）。
blocks.en: Observe against the black background (A): repeat the observation. The black background suits the detection of white, transparent and light-colored particles (such as glass fragments, protein aggregates and crystals).

blocks.zh: 記錄可見粒子：記錄存在與否及性質描述（數量、顏色、形態）。
blocks.en: Record visible particles: record whether particles are present and describe their nature (number, color, morphology).

blocks.zh: 黑白雙背景的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Dual Black/White Backgrounds

blocks.zh: 同一個粒子在不同背景下的能見度完全不同：白色纖維在黑色背景上清晰可見，卻在白色背景上幾乎消失；深色橡膠顆粒在白色背景上一目了然，在黑色背景上卻難以發現。因此Ph.Eur.規定兩個背景都必須使用，才能不遺漏任何類型的可見異物。
blocks.en: The same particle can look completely different against different backgrounds: a white fiber is clearly visible against black but almost disappears against white, while a dark rubber fragment stands out against white but is hard to spot against black. Ph.Eur. therefore requires that both backgrounds be used, so that no type of visible particle is missed.

blocks.zh: 5秒觀察時間的根據
blocks.en: Basis for the 5-Second Observation Time

blocks.zh: 約5秒是依據人眼掃視速度和視覺暫留特性確定的——足夠讓懸浮粒子移動並被注意到，但不至於使眼睛疲勞造成主觀判斷誤差。有色容器或混濁製劑（如疫苗佐劑）可適當延長觀察時間。
blocks.en: The approximately 5 seconds is based on the eye's scanning speed and persistence of vision: long enough for suspended particles to move and be noticed, but not so long that eye fatigue introduces subjective error. For colored containers or turbid preparations (such as vaccine adjuvants), the observation time may be extended as appropriate.

blocks.zh: 轉移容器的適用情形
blocks.en: When to Transfer the Container Contents

blocks.zh: 若產品在原容器中無法目視（例如：不透明容器、深色玻璃瓶、大體積容器形狀不適合），可轉移至透明無粒子的樣品容器中再檢查。但轉移操作本身可能引入污染，需在潔淨環境下小心操作並記錄操作條件。
blocks.en: If the product cannot be inspected visually in its original container (for example, opaque containers, dark glass bottles, or large containers whose shape is unsuitable), it may be transferred to a clear, particle-free sample container and then inspected. However, the transfer itself may introduce contamination, so it must be carried out carefully in a clean environment and the operating conditions recorded.

blocks.zh: 判讀原則與法規定位
blocks.en: Interpretation Principles and Regulatory Position

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 2.9.20的判讀框架
blocks.en: Interpretive Framework of Ph.Eur. 2.9.20

blocks.zh: 本章只規定測試方法，不規定具體的數量限度——接受標準由各個品項專論（Individual monograph）自行規定。典型表述為：
blocks.en: This chapter specifies only the test method and sets no numerical limits; acceptance criteria are set by each individual monograph. Typical wording is:

blocks.zh: "Essentially free from visible particles"（本質上不含可見異物）
blocks.en: "Essentially free from visible particles"

blocks.zh: "Practically free from particles"（實際上無異物）
blocks.en: "Practically free from particles"

blocks.zh: 通常「看到任何可見粒子」即為不合格，但氣泡除外（氣泡迅速消散，且是液體製劑的固有現象）。
blocks.en: Generally, "seeing any visible particle" means failure, with the exception of air bubbles (bubbles dissipate quickly and are an inherent feature of liquid preparations).

blocks.zh: 可見異物 vs 次可見微粒：完整視覺管控框架
blocks.en: Visible vs Sub-visible Particles: The Complete Visual Control Framework

blocks.zh: CDMO放行管控應用
blocks.en: Application to CDMO Release Control

blocks.zh: 100%目視檢查（AVI，Automated Visual Inspection 或 MVI，Manual Visual Inspection）：每支注射劑均需依Ph.Eur. 2.9.20原則進行目視，確認無可見異物後才能放行。這是最後一道品質關卡。
blocks.en: 100% visual inspection (AVI, Automated Visual Inspection, or MVI, Manual Visual Inspection): every injectable unit must be inspected visually according to the principles of Ph.Eur. 2.9.20, and released only after confirming that no visible particles are present. This is the last quality gate.

blocks.zh: 自動化視覺檢查機（AVI）：原理相同（黑白背景、指定照度），但以攝影機取代人眼，需依PICS Annex 1 §8.116–8.125規定及PDA TR85指引進行驗證。
blocks.en: Automated visual inspection machine (AVI): the principle is the same (black and white backgrounds, specified illumination), but a camera replaces the human eye. It must be validated in line with PIC/S Annex 1 §8.116–8.125 and the PDA TR85 guidance.

blocks.zh: 可見異物調查：若發現可見異物，需進行粒子鑑別（形態、材質），追溯來源（玻璃、橡膠、金屬、纖維、蛋白質聚集體）並啟動偏差調查。
blocks.en: Visible particle investigation: if visible particles are found, the particles must be identified (morphology, material), the source traced (glass, rubber, metal, fibers, protein aggregates), and a deviation investigation initiated.

blocks.zh: 與次可見微粒的銜接：放行時同時滿足2.9.20（無可見異物）和2.9.19（微粒計數符合限度）才視為完整合規。
blocks.en: Link to sub-visible particles: a batch is considered fully compliant at release only if it meets both 2.9.20 (no visible particles) and 2.9.19 (particle counts within limits).

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. vs USP 比較
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. vs USP Comparison

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 2.9.20：規定設備（黑/白板 + 2000–3750 lux）及操作程序（5秒、無放大、雙背景）。
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 2.9.20: specifies the equipment (black/white panels + 2000–3750 lux) and the operating procedure (5 seconds, no magnification, dual backgrounds).

blocks.zh: USP <790>（Visible Particulates in Injections）：類似框架，但規定更詳細（包括標準品確認程序）。
blocks.en: USP <790> (Visible Particulates in Injections): a similar framework, but with more detailed requirements (including confirmation procedures using reference standards).

blocks.zh: USP <1790>（Visual Inspection of Injections）：詳細指引，包含MVI/AVI、POD（Probability of Detection）、Knapp Study、檢驗員資格確認等完整驗證框架，為USP <790>的補充指南。
blocks.en: USP <1790> (Visual Inspection of Injections): detailed guidance covering MVI/AVI, POD (Probability of Detection), the Knapp study, inspector qualification and other elements of a complete validation framework; it is the supplementary guide to USP <790>.

blocks.zh: 實際上，Ph.Eur. 2.9.20 提供的是「最基礎框架」，各廠在藥典基礎上需建立更詳細的操作規程（含POD驗證、人員訓練確認等）。
blocks.en: In practice, Ph.Eur. 2.9.20 provides only the "basic framework"; each site needs to build more detailed operating procedures on top of the pharmacopoeia (including POD validation and confirmation of personnel training).
